full_judgment: No.1, Rahima Khatun and one Harun-or-Rashid who became the owner and possessor of the land measuring 30 decimals appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.90. corresponding to S.A. Khatian No. 154 and B.S. Khatian No. Ill, previous Dag No. 152 and at present Dag No. 450 under J.L. No. 46, Mouza-Dotola Gobindopur, P.S. Chandina, District-Comilla, by way of purchase vide sale deed No. 9907 dated 21.10.1975 executed by one Bidhu Bhushan Acharya. Then they filed application before the Revenue Officer for mutating their name in respect of the aforementioned land but at the point of time it reveals that the aforesaid land was wrongly inserted in the list of vested property. Eventually, on their prayer the V.P. Case No. 38 of 1997 and 77 of 1998 were started and heard together on 05.07.1999 and after hearing of the said V.P. cases the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue). Comilla was pleased to pass an order releasing the land from the list of vested property (Annexure-D to the writ petition). Thereafter the aforesaid Harun-or-Rashid sold out his portion of land to the petitioner No.2, Qari Md. Asmat Ali, vide sale deed No. 7200 dated 08.09.2002. By this way the petitioner Nos.1 and 2 became the owners of the aforesaid land by way of purchase and thereby they were possessing the same without interruption from any quarter. Then the petitioners for their better enjoyment executed an agreement between them for amicable partition in respect of the land in question and thereby they are peacefully possessing the same by erecting their sami pacca houses thereon and are Irving there with their family members from long before.
